ui.title: Receipt overview
ui.categoryEstimateInfo: OFF calculated scores and nutrient levels for the reviewed category as a single-ingredient food: {ingredient}. Green-Score uses the France context with defaults for missing origin, labels and packaging. This does not establish allergens or certifications for your purchase.
ui.additivesFoundIn: Found in {n} product | Found in {n} products
ui.carbonReferenceNote: 2050 reference · All activities, not just food
ui.carbonReferenceInfo: Nos Gestes Climat uses 2,000 kg CO₂e per person per year as a collective reference for 2050. Dividing by 52 gives about 38.5 kg per week, across all activities. The comparison covers the whole basket, which may feed several people or last several days. It is not a measure of your weekly footprint or remaining allowance.

priceSortInfo.price: Total spent on each product, including all quantities bought.
priceSortInfo.unitPrice: Total spent divided by the number of items bought.

ui.noSource: No product or category source available
ui.referenceInfo: Category estimate using {name}. Nutrients are per 100 g of edible food; peel and other inedible parts may affect totals. Missing grades are not inferred.
ui.glutenFreeLabels: Among products with no gluten listed: {count} labelled gluten-free.
ui.weightInfo: Based on {known} of {total} products. Uses total receipt weight where supplied, otherwise package mass × quantity. Drinks sold by volume are counted as 1 ml ≈ 1 g.
ui.basketInfo: Charts count distinct products, not packages or weight. Repeated barcodes are merged. Loose produce with the same reference and analysis data is merged; purchased amounts still contribute to totals. Category averages are labelled Estimated. Unknown values remain unknown.

info.nutriscore: Published Nutri-Score grades, A–E. Percentages use all distinct products in the receipt, including unknown grades. Each distinct product counts once; no basket average is calculated. Unknown includes products without a published grade. Select a grade to see its products.
info.nova: Processing groups, 1–4. Group 4 is ultra-processed. Confirmed raw-produce references are classified as group 1 using the NOVA definition and labelled Estimated. Other missing groups stay unknown.
info.greenScore: Published Green-Score grades, A+–F. Each distinct product counts once. No average or category grade is invented; unknown products stay visible. Select a grade to see its products.
info.additives: Distinct additive tags reported by Open Food Facts, and how many distinct products contain them. An additive appearing in several products counts once. Missing additive data stays unknown. This is a count, not a health-risk assessment.
info.nutrients: Per-100 g or per-100 ml values × the purchased mass or volume ÷ 100. Only products with both a known value and amount are included. Fresh-produce averages come from CIQUAL 2020; less-than values and missing values are excluded rather than turned into exact numbers.
info.carbon: AGRIBALYSE kg CO₂e per kg × purchased weight in kg. The estimate covers the food lifecycle and is not a measurement of your individual purchase. Products missing weight or reference data are excluded. Drinks need a known mass; volume is not assumed to equal mass.
info.labels: Products with organic or fair-trade labels reported by Open Food Facts. Coverage counts products with label data. An absent label does not prove a product is uncertified.
info.spending: Unit price × quantity bought, summed across receipt lines. Missing prices are excluded. Receipt extraction must supply a unit price, not a line total.
info.highNutrients: Uses Open Food Facts’ published high nutrient levels based on 100 g / 100 ml, not basket totals. Missing levels are excluded. These describe food composition, not a personal medical recommendation.
info.allergens: Contains uses declared allergen tags; May contain uses trace tags. Not listed requires ingredient data plus allergen and trace fields. Missing data stays Unknown. No gluten listed is not proof of suitability for coeliac disease: check packaging and gluten-free labels. We only show certification when a specific certification source is supplied.
info.highlights: Nutri-Score D/E, NOVA 4 and Green-Score D/E/F are highlighted. Optional high sugar, salt and fat checks use published Open Food Facts nutrient levels. Each product appears once with all reasons. Missing data cannot clear a product.

ui.saturatedReference: French adult reference: maximum 12% of energy
ui.sugarReferenceLabel: Sugars excluding lactose · adult daily maximum
ui.macroReferenceNote: Compared with French adult dietary references. Purchased food is not daily intake, and these ranges are not individual prescriptions.
ui.macroCalculation: Estimated energy from carbohydrates and protein (4 kcal/g) and fat (9 kcal/g), divided by the published energy of the same purchased products. Published kcal are used, or kJ converted to kcal. Only products with all three macronutrients, energy and a purchased weight or volume are included; products reporting polyols are excluded from the three-ring estimate. Fibre, alcohol and label rounding can mean the three shares do not sum to 100%. Rings show energy shares, not progress towards a target. Saturated fat uses 9 kcal/g and has its own coverage. The gram breakdown includes all products with that nutrient, so its coverage can differ from the rings. French adult references: carbohydrates 40–55%, fat 35–40%, protein 10–20%, saturated fat maximum 12% of energy (ANSES, Table 4). Fibre 30 g/day and sugars excluding lactose maximum 100 g/day are general daily references; no daily intake or lactose-free sugar total is inferred from the receipt.
